summary: Figure 5A reports pathway enrichment and counts of regulated genes for the five-day treatment, without gene identities or effects. The supplement’s named glial-marker results come from a four-day assay, and all 30 GEO sample files contain read counts. Gene-level concordance remains unassessed. [Manuscript](https://push-zb.helmholtz-munich.de/deliver.php?id=19738) · [Supplement](https://ars.els-cdn.com/content/image/1-s2.0-S1550413117305508-mmc1.pdf)
openIssues: Figure 5A and the GEO overview report five mice per group. The registered analysis uses six samples per arm. The authors’ GSM inclusion list and five-day gene-level results are needed to reopen the comparison.
A separate Helmholtz attachment labelled research data returned zero bytes. Its contents remain unknown.
